lessons.claim: Integrating a binned profile with np.cumsum takes the WHOLE bin containing the lower limit instead of half of it, a +bin/(2 L) bias -- measured +1.65 % at bin/l_g = 0.0374 against a 2 % decision band, and the same error in a CDF left a sampler's mean 0.44 % low with KS at 96 % of the 95 % critical value. Use the trapezoid rule and assert the residual as the law (bin/L)^2/8.
